Whenever changes are made for input assumptions, users need to press the F9 key so that
GREET recalculates results with the new input assumptions.
The GREET model is designed with the so-called circular calculation feature in Excel in order to account for secondary energy and emission
effects. In circular calculations, if a cell requiring a value is accidentally inputted with a non-value entry, the whole
model may be corrupted, and the model cannot be repaired by inputting a value to the same cell. Users are strongly
recommended to save their work frequently and keep the original copy of the GREET model as a backup.
